item.title: Trump promises Americans $5K if GOP wins. And, Kirk supporters reflect on his death
item.description: President Trump tries to incentivize voters by promising $5,000 to Americans if the GOP wins the midterms. And, young conservatives reflect on the party one year after Charlie Kirk's death.

item.title: After Trump promised to pay $5,000 if Republicans win, here's what to expect Thursday
item.description: President Trump promised to send every adult citizen $5,000, but only if Republicans maintain control of Congress in the midterm election, setting high expectations for the convention's final night.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured
item.description: The European climate service Copernicus said the Earth just sweltered through its hottest month on record in August. Scientists said the heat surge is mostly due to human-caused climate change.

item.title: A pilot of the Amazon cargo plane in Miami crash warned it was coming in too fast
item.description: For nearly two minutes, one of the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane that careened off a Miami runway repeatedly warned his counterpart they were going too fast, according to flight information.

item.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
item.description: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

item.title: A huge 11th-century tapestry of the Norman Conquest has (carefully) traveled to England
item.description: Part war propaganda, part comic strip, the 230-foot Bayeux Tapestry is back in England for the first time in 900 years. It depicts the 1066 Battle of Hastings, which ended Anglo-Saxon rule.

item.title: Conductor Julian Wachner receives suspended sentence for possession of child sex abuse material
item.description: The formerly prominent, widely recorded conductor was sentenced Wednesday to nearly six years of probation for five counts of possession of child sex abuse material in Indianapolis.

item.title: Special education head at Education Department abruptly resigns
